svg.aria-label: Sam Barber. A pixel-art sea chart of a language archipelago: each island is a programming language and its land area is its share of code. Python 31.8%, JavaScript 25.2%, TeX 11.4%, Other 8.4%, PowerShell 7.7%, C++ 6.3%, Shell 5.4%, SystemVerilog 3.8%. A small sailing boat follows a dotted course between the islands.
